summary: Evernorth Holdings filed an 8-K reporting a September 11, 2026 note purchase agreement with NH Investment Securities, as trustee, for $30.0 million of 4.00% Convertible Senior PIK Notes due 2031. Closing is conditioned on the company's business combination with Armada Acquisition Corp. II, expected in Q4 2026. The notes are senior unsecured obligations with an 8.0% yield-to-put upon default or a fundamental transaction. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes, including XRP acquisition. Watch the merger closing and conversion terms.
